scope: resolved skills.character_source -> canonical character identity bridge
rules: Canonical character names remain authoritative; this bridge does not rewrite source wording.
Only exact evidence-backed character identities are promoted from the unresolved token inventory.
A skill may resolve to multiple canonical character identities when the evidence explicitly names multiple forms/users.
Conflicting or variant-ambiguous source strings remain unresolved in the gap inventory.
